description: Points along the path of the 2 August 2027 eclipse for which our oracle computed totality once — towns, capes, peaks, monuments — with the cloud range of two reanalyses at each. Points, not destinations: nothing was priced there and no entry or access was read. Points outside the path carry no totality. No coordinates are taken: the list is fixed, and a place absent from it has not been computed.

country.description: Keep one country, by ISO code or English name, whatever the case, e.g. ES or Spain.

in_path.description: true keeps points inside the path of totality, false those outside.

max_cloud_pct.description: Keep points whose cloud range stays at or under this percentage at its high end.

min_totality_seconds.description: Keep points with at least this much totality, in seconds.

sort.description: name (default) is the order of the file; totality puts the longest first.

name: list_eclipse_sites
title: Points along the 2027 path, with totality and cloud
